#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"; rmdir "$HOME/.lock"' EXIT
work=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/x.XXXXXX")
rm -rf "$work"
out="$tmp/out"; rm -rf "$out"
rm -rf ./build node_modules .cache
rm -f "$HOME/.lock"
go clean -testcache
go env GOMODCACHE
go build -modcacherw ./...
# rm -rf "$HOME" in a comment is not run
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
find "$tmp" -name '*.log' -delete
find "$HOME/.config" -name x -print
# cleanuplint:allow the fixture shows a directive that carries a written reason
rm -rf "$HOME/.allowed" # allowed:env-path-delete
scratch=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/x.XXXXXX")
rm -rf "$scratch"
legacy=`mktemp -d "$HOME/x.XXXXXX"`
rm -rf "$legacy"
testargs=(test -count=1 ./...)
go "${testargs[@]}"
go clean -modcache=false
go clean -cache=0 -fuzzcache=f -testcache
go clean -modcache="false"
go clean -testcache; echo -cache
echo "go clean with -modcache empties the shared cache"
go clean -n ./...
go -C ./sub clean -testcache
